title: docs.create_document
description: Create a document (the ingest seam — ironmemo dumps transcripts/summaries through it). `body` is a utf-8 string; `folder_path` like "/Meetings/2026-08" creates folders idempotently. Unknown `type` fails loudly. Returns {document_id: str}. Authority travels in the payload: `actor_id` is authorized like an HTTP caller (docs.edit in the workspace), or `caller_service` must be listed in STAPEL_DOCS['INTERNAL_TRUSTED_SERVICES']; `owner_id` other than the actor must itself be a workspace member.

actor_id.description: User the call acts for; authorized for docs.edit in this workspace.

caller_service.description: Name of a service acting without a user actor; accepted only when the host trusts it explicitly.
